components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terracotta action button for the single primary task on a view.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White surface button with strong border for secondary actions.

narrative.overview: A warm, paper-like, academic interface grounded in institutional credibility, legible documentation, and restrained authority. Think of a prestigious university registrar's office rather than a generic tech SaaS tool. The canvas is ivory paper (#F7F5F0), content rests on crisp white surfaces (#FFFFFF), text is charcoal ink (#252525), and a single verified university orange accent is deployed with deliberate discipline.
keyCharacteristics: Academic Warmth: Ivory document ground paired with deep charcoal ink and rich university orange.
Structural Integrity: Precision 1px borders and subtle tonal shifts take precedence over soft drop shadows.
Serif Dignity: Editorial serif headlines (Source Serif 4) anchor pages with authoritative scholarship.
Tabular Precision: Monospace and tabular numerals ensure financial fee tables and room allocations align impeccably.

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Rule
rules.body: University brand orange (#F26522) and primary terracotta (#C2410C) must occupy no more than 10% of any viewport. If a screen looks orange, the visual hierarchy has collapsed.

rules.name: The Dual-Encoding Status Rule
rules.body: Status states must never be conveyed by color alone. Every badge, alert, and indicator must pair its color with an explicit text label or unambiguous semantic icon.

rules.name: The Single-H1 Rule
rules.body: Each route contains exactly one <h1> element communicating the document's primary operational purpose.

rules.name: The Zero-Float Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never float or cast heavy shadows at rest. Elevation is demonstrated strictly by border contrast and subtle 1px state shifts.

rules.name: The Anti-Pill Rule
rules.body: Interactive buttons, text inputs, and content cards must never use circular pill shapes. Rectilinear geometry with subtle 4px corner softening is the unbroken standard.

dos: Do sample and verify the exact orange hue (#F26522) from the official circular LPU logo.
Do use Source Serif 4 for headings to establish credible university atmosphere.
Do format all currency (₹), room numbers, and dates with tabular-nums.
Do maintain a strict 2px high-visibility focus ring (#F26522) for complete keyboard accessibility.
Do keep page background warm ivory (#F7F5F0) and content containers clean white (#FFFFFF).
donts: Don't introduce blue, cyan, purple, or neon accents anywhere in the UI.
Don't use decorative background gradients, glassmorphism, or backdrop blur effects.
Don't use emojis as primary interface navigation or status icons.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons or oversized 16px+ border radii on standard cards.
Don't recolor or distort the official LPU seal; present it faithfully on black or white.
